$comment: Contract for the AmendOutcome server-side command (requirements log row 39). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration). Custom API parameter Type codes: 10=String.

customApi.name: al_AmendOutcome
customApi.description: Amends the File grade and/or the Advice grade a check first gave a case, at any stage, with a reason. The case does not move. Needs the case.amendoutcome capability; writes an Audit Event naming the grades before and after.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcomecase whose grades are amended.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why the grades are amended; kept on the audit event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

requestParameters.name: FileGrade
requestParameters.description: New File grade: Pass or Fail. Empty leaves it as it is.

requestParameters.name: AdviceGrade
requestParameters.description: New Advice grade: Pass, Pass with issues, Insufficient evidence or Potential harm. Empty leaves it as it is.

responseProperties.name: Summary
responseProperties.description: The grades before and after, as written to the audit event.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.
